facilities.source: https://dwr.virginia.gov/camping-on-wmas/ ('no amenities (electric, potable water, dump stations, restrooms, convenience stations)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Camping on a Virginia WMA needs a written camping authorization ($10, up to six people) from Go Outdoors Virginia or a license agent, which sets the trip's start and end dates; 14 nights at most. Only in previously cleared spots, and 'unlawful to camp within 300 feet of any lake or facility'. DWR: 'WMA roads are not suitable for long vehicles or trailers ... Some WMAs may not allow travel trailers or RVs.' Big Survey lists 'Primitive Camping' among its recreational opportunities. It 'is in the earliest stages of development': 'Two parking areas provide access to the Tower Trail and the High Rocks Trail. Additional parking areas will become available as DWR develops this property.' State Route 640 bisects the property.

booking.source: https://dwr.virginia.gov/camping-on-wmas/ + https://dwr.virginia.gov/wma/big-survey/ (Overview, Facilities, Maps & Directions, Recreational Opportunities), read 2026-10-21
